---
# ocp4_workload_quarry_streams defaults
become_override: false
ocp_username: opentlc-mgr
silent: false

quarry_streams_namespace: quarry-streams
quarry_streams_catalog_source: community-operators
quarry_streams_channel: stable-3.2
quarry_streams_starting_csv: ""
quarry_streams_brokers: 3

# ocp4_workload_quarry_streams defaults

quarry_streams_channel: stable-3.2

quarry_streams_brokers: 3

---
# ocp4_workload_quarry_streams defaults
become_override: false
ocp_username: opentlc-mgr
silent: false

quarry_streams_namespace: quarry-streams
quarry_streams_catalog_source: community-operators
quarry_streams_channel: stable-3.2
quarry_streams_starting_csv: ""
quarry_streams_brokers: 3

---
- name: Read the package manifest for quarry-streams-operator
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    oc get packagemanifest quarry-streams-operator -n openshift-marketplace
    -o jsonpath='{{.status.channels[*].name}}'
  register: quarry_pkg
  changed_when: false

- name: Create the operator subscription
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: subscription.yaml.j2
  vars:
    subscription_channel: "{{ quarry_streams_channel }}"
    subscription_source: "{{ quarry_streams_catalog_source }}"

- name: Wait for the subscription to resolve
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: quarry_sub.resources[0].status.state | default('') == 'AtLatestKnown'
